text: Who in this group would you NOT trust to keep a secret? Say it or take a shot.
What's something you told only one person in this barkada and never told the rest?
Who here did you not like when you first met, and what changed your mind?
{p1}, if you got arrested tonight, who here would bail you out first, and who would just laugh?
What's the pettiest reason you've ever been annoyed at someone at this table?
Have you ever had a crush on someone in this barkada? You don't have to say who.
What's the biggest utang someone in this group owes you, and do you think you'll ever see it again?
Which barkada trip or night out do you still think about the most, and why?
What's a message you sent to the group chat that you still regret?
The Tanggero picks someone to answer: who in this group gives the worst advice with the most confidence?
Have you ever made up an excuse to skip a barkada hangout? What was the real reason?
{p1}, what's one thing this barkada always does that you secretly can't stand?
Who here have you talked about behind their back, and was it good or bad?
What's a friendship you let fade on purpose, and would you fix it if you could?
If this barkada got stranded on an island in Palawan, who survives the longest, and who goes first?
Have you ever been jealous of a friend's success? Spill or shot.

Everyone who has muted this barkada's group chat at least once, drink.
Everyone who has screenshotted something from this group and shared it outside the group, drink.
Everyone who has borrowed money from someone at this table and still hasn't paid it back, drink.
Everyone who is in a side group chat that leaves out someone in this room, drink.
Everyone who has pretended to like a friend's partner just to keep the peace, drink.
Most likely to leave the group chat on 'seen' for three days. Point on 3.
Most likely to cancel plans five minutes before the meetup. Point on 3.
Most likely to cry first at a barkada despedida. Point on 3.
Most likely to still be in this exact barkada twenty years from now. Point on 3.
Hot Seat: {p1} answers three questions from the group about their oldest friendship. One shot skips one.
Hot Seat: you take three questions from the group about the worst barkada fight you've been part of. One shot skips one.
If you had to cut one person at this table from your life, who goes? Say it, or take 2 shots.
What's the meanest thing you've said about someone here when they weren't around? Spill, or take 2 shots.
Water Break. Everyone drinks water. Real friends make sure the whole barkada gets home safe.
Which member of this barkada would you call first at 3 AM, and why them?
Who here is always the last to pay their share of the bill, and do you still love them anyway?
What's the most awkward moment you've seen in this barkada that nobody ever talks about?
{p1}, what's one thing this barkada misunderstands about you?

Which friend's advice did you ignore, only to find out later they were right?
Who here would survive the longest without their phone, and who would panic first?
What's the longest you've gone without talking to someone in this barkada, and why?

What secret did you keep for a friend that almost made you crack?
{p1}, if {p2} announced they were moving abroad tomorrow, what would you say first?
Have you ever taken credit for a barkada plan that wasn't your idea?
What was the first thing you noticed about this barkada when you joined it?
Who here knows your most embarrassing story, and have they ever used it against you?
Have you ever left a barkada outing early because the vibe felt off? What happened?

Everyone who has been the last to leave a barkada hangout, drink.
Everyone who has complained that the group chat is too noisy and then sent twenty messages, drink.
Everyone who has been tagged in a photo they begged the group to delete, drink.
Everyone who has heard about a barkada plan afterward and felt left out, drink.
Everyone who has argued with a friend over who owes whom money, drink.
Most likely to organize the next barkada trip and then cancel it. Point on 3.
Most likely to start drama and then act completely innocent. Point on 3.
Most likely to forget everyone's birthday except their own. Point on 3.
Hot Seat: {p1} answers three questions from the group about their best barkada memory. One shot skips one.
Hot Seat: you take three questions from the group about your biggest barkada confession. One shot skips one.
Who here would you call the most two-faced, and when did you first notice? Say it, or take 2 shots.
What's the biggest lie you've told this barkada, and do they know yet? Spill, or take 2 shots.
